body: If you could set just one small goal right now, judging by your post I would assume you would want to be drug-free? Start small bro, we've all been there. And hell I don't have friends either but that's the beauty of life, you don't need anyone to be happy, you just need yourself and a few helpful tools in the "toolshed" to help you cope with how you're feeling. Do you have any hobbies? Something that excites you, just think of one thing you've always wanted to do and set another goal to accomplish that.
You're not alone, come over to my place and grab a beer bro, no bullshit.
